issues.suggestion: Extend the AAPL price history used for volatility, drawdown and VaR to at least a full year before treating the 'low' symbol risk level as reliable.

issues.message: The factor set only contains momentum_20d -0.08374539342684684, volatility_20d 0.25728333030286615, rsi_14d 30.57142460485487 and volume_ratio 0.9114299623086248; no 60-day momentum or 60-day volatility is reported, so the HOLD consensus (-0.4) is built without any medium-term factor evidence.
issues.suggestion: Add the 60-day momentum and 60-day volatility factors so the position review is not driven only by 20-day signals while momentum shows STRONG_SELL.

issues.message: Only one of the five strategies has a backtest: ma_cross with trade_count 3 and fill_count 6, sharpe_ratio -5.7833, total_return -0.0177 and max_drawdown -0.0177. There is no backtest for momentum (which carries the STRONG_SELL signal -2), rsi_reversion, bollinger_reversion or macd, and 3 closed round trips cannot support a Sharpe of -5.7833.
issues.suggestion: Backtest the remaining strategies and extend the tested history so the ma_cross statistics are based on substantially more than 3 round trips before relying on any of them.

issues.message: Two portfolio bases are reported: exposure total_value 17866.41 (weights_basis: summed value of priced holdings, cash excluded) and portfolio_risk var_base_value 19366.41 (var_basis: analytics service equity, may include cash). var_95_pct 1.4092, var_99_pct 1.9947 and cvar_95_pct 1.7411 are therefore computed against a base 1500.00 larger than the priced exposure, so the VaR percentages do not describe the same portfolio as the AAPL weight 23.1282%.
issues.suggestion: Report VaR percentages on the same priced-exposure base as the position weights, or state the cash component explicitly, so risk and concentration figures are comparable.

issues.message: portfolio_risk is labelled level 'low' and the portfolio_risk check passes, yet the same metrics show sharpe_ratio -0.2534, alpha -0.0802, cumulative_return -0.0437, beta 0.8376 and correlation_to_spy 0.8791; the 'low' label reflects only var_95_pct 1.4092 under var_medium_pct 2.0 and ignores the negative risk-adjusted performance and high market correlation.
issues.suggestion: Qualify the portfolio risk level with the negative Sharpe and alpha and the 0.8791 correlation to SPY, or recompute it over a longer history, so 'low' risk is not read as a clean bill of health.
